`sscanf('77 xx', '%d %d')` answered `['77', '']`. php answers `[77, NULL]`. The
first element is a string where php has an int, so `is_int()`, `===` and
`var_dump()` all lie about the result of the one builtin whose purpose is to
type its input; the second is an empty string where php has `NULL`, so "did
this field match" cannot be asked at all. Both are silent: the call compiles,
runs, and hands back plausible-looking data.
